title: In Splunk App for Stream versions below 8.1.7, an unauthenticated user could cause Splunk App for… (CVE-2026-131301)
description: In Splunk App for Stream versions below 8.1.7, an unauthenticated user can cause the application to reset its in-memory indexer cache. This occurs because the Splunk Web handler processes cache-reset requests without requiring user authentication. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
